answer: The skin depth (penetration depth) $\delta$ is given by:$$\delta = \sqrt{\frac{2}{\omega \mu \sigma}}$$Given: Resistivity $\rho = 1.69 \times 10^{-8}\ \Omega\text{-m}$, so conductivity $\sigma = \frac{1}{\rho} = \frac{1}{1.69 \times 10^{-8}} \approx 5.917 \times 10^7\ \text{S/m}$. Frequency $f = 10^7\ \text{MHz} = 10^7 \times 10^6\ \text{Hz} = 10^{13}\ \text{Hz}$. Angular frequency $\omega = 2\pi f = 2\pi \times 10^{13}\ \text{rad/s}$. For copper, $\mu \approx \mu_0 = 4\pi \times 10^{-7}\ \text{H/m}$. Substituting the values:$$\delta = \sqrt{\frac{2}{(2\pi \times 10^{13}) \times (4\pi \times 10^{-7}) \times (5.917 \times 10^7)}} \approx 1.64 \times 10^{-7}\ \text{m}$$
proTip: Pay close attention to unit conversions, especially mega-hertz ($10^6$) and given frequency prefix scaling.
